name: Ore no Nioi wa Hatsujou Switch
original_name: 俺のニオイは発情スイッチ
source:
"W-What are you sniffing at!"

Nio Katsutoshi, protagonist and judo club affiliate, was having a bit of a freakout out the train.
That's because Shimizu Rinka, the student president whom everyone adored, was smelling him.

On the best of days Katsutoshi had a complex about his body odor.
It wafted to any distance, and it was embarrassing. His cheeks burned with shame.

But, looking at Rinka, he saw her face was blushing even redder.

His scent was a trigger that seemed to be making her aroused!

What's more, it had wafted into the nostrils of Kumakura Isuzu, his childhood friend......

This is the story - your story - of Nio Katsutoshi,
the object of affection of kun-kun scent fetish heroines.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE160271.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“你、你在闻什么！”

柔道部成员、主人公仁王胜利在电车上慌乱不已，因为深受众人喜爱的学生会长清水凛花正在闻他。

胜利一直对自己的体味抱有自卑。气味会飘到很远，让他尴尬不已，羞得双颊发烫。

但他看向凛花时，却发现她的脸红得更加厉害。

他的气味似乎成了让她兴奋的开关！

更糟的是，这股气味还飘进了青梅竹马熊仓五十铃的鼻子……

这是仁王胜利——也是你的故事：你将成为迷恋“闻闻”气味的女主角们所爱慕的对象。

[改编自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE160271.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
